messages:
anya: heads-up — hf-sync failed onboarding axolotl-13b-v2 on CI. saw auth timeouts while fetching safetensors shards, then the generated shard index (safesplit.map) had mismatched offsets so the converter panicked.

sam: ugh. which step? download or merge? any logs?

anya: download stage. CI log shows 401/timeout retries then a partial manifest write. snippet: 
```
ERROR: hf_sync: failed to download shard 00002.safetensors - 524 timeout
WARN: writing partial safesplit index to /tmp/hf-sync/axolotl/safesplit.map.tmp
ERROR: safesplit: index checksum mismatch on rename, expecting 0x3a4f... got 0x0000...
panic: weight key mapping missing for shard 2
```

mike: that rename race looks familiar — we hit something similar when hub retries returned different etag ordering. does hf-sync use atomic rename?

anya: it tries to write .tmp then os.Rename but the CI runner sometimes restarts the downloader job and a second hf-sync process picks up the same target dir and renames the .tmp concurrently. looks like our code assumes single-writer.

sam: could also be the revision pin fallback. if a download fails and hf-sync falls back to a different revision, shard filenames changed and the index map points to wrong file. did you see any revision mismatch in logs?

anya: yes — log shows initial attempt to download at revision "v2.0.1" then fallback to "main" for two small shards. result: safesplit.map references 00002.safetensors@v2.0.1 but 00002.safetensors actually came from main with different weightkey ordering.

mike: hmmm. two separate bugs then: 1) non-atomic multi-process rename/race, 2) revision fallback mixing shards. both cause weight key rename/lookup to fail in converter.

deploy-bot: CI build 3421 failed — step hf-sync-onboard (exit 1)

anya: workaround I pushed to the CI job for now: set HF_SYNC_SINGLE_WRITER=1 and HF_TOKEN in the runner env so no fallback to anonymous downloads. also disabled parallel chunking by setting HF_SYNC_CHUNKS=1. it lets the job finish end-to-end consistently.

sam: good temporary fix. we should add a robust lock file and require consistent revision pinning across retries. also the converter should validate per-shard weightkey signatures and refuse to merge if inconsistencies found, with better error messages.

mike: filing a tracking issue and small patch. plan:
- add PID/file lock for safesplit.map writes (drop-in rename only after lock)
- record revision id in each shard metadata and validate on finalization
- make revision fallback opt-in with explicit flag --allow-revision-fallback
- add unit test that simulates partial download + concurrent hf-sync process

anya: thanks. I have a failing quantization eval that depends on this model; the runaway unit-token alignment break caused a quality regression in our 8-bit run. if onboarding is flaky we stall the whole bench.

mike: ack. will prioritize. creating PR 4872 for the lock + revision header. adding test harness to reproduce the etag ordering case.

ops-bot: note: created issue #PT-982 on tracker for safesplit race and assigned to mike.

sam: for immediate stability, can we have hf-sync write a small per-model manifest file with checksums of each shard and a human-readable mapping (no binary)? then converter can sanity-check before merging.

anya: yep added that to the PR comments. also documented the CI env vars we used in the onboarding runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/hf-sync-onboard (private).

mike: ok merging small fix to prevent concurrent renames. leaving the revision-fallback design to follow-up. will cut a hotfix release for hf-sync tomorrow morning.

anya: thanks team. once hotfix is out I'll re-run the quantization eval and post results. :pray:

deploy-bot: hotfix build queued (#4872)

anya: one more gotcha — if anyone else hits this locally, you can reproduce by running two concurrent: 
```bash
HF_TOKEN=... ./hf-sync model axolotl-13b-v2 --out /tmp/ax && ./hf-sync model axolotl-13b-v2 --out /tmp/ax2 &
```
observe safesplit.map.tmp collisions.

sam: perfect repro, thanks. I'll add that to the test case.

mike: ping me in #eng-oncall if it goes flaky after the hotfix, will watch CI tomorrow morning.

anya: noted.
